title: Grade 2 Math — Wed, May 27
description: 2D Shapes — Day 3 of 5: Shapes in real life and symmetry
subject: mathematics

questions.question: A clock face is shaped like a ___.
questions.explanation: A clock face is circular — perfectly round with no sides or corners.

questions.question: A piece of chocolate bar is shaped like a ___.
questions.explanation: A chocolate bar piece is a rectangle — 4 sides, 2 long and 2 short.

questions.question: Which shape has a line of symmetry down the middle?
questions.explanation: Both a circle and a square have symmetry — if you fold them down the middle, both halves match.

questions.question: A slice of bread is shaped like a ___.
questions.explanation: A bread slice is a rectangle — 4 sides, taller than it is wide.

questions.question: Which 2D shape has the SAME number of sides and corners as its sides?
questions.explanation: Every polygon (closed shape with straight sides) has the same number of sides and corners. Triangle: 3 sides, 3 corners. Square: 4 sides, 4 corners.

questions.question: A window is shaped like a ___.
questions.explanation: Most windows are squares or rectangles — 4 sides with right-angle corners.

questions.question: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
questions.explanation: A square has 4 lines of symmetry: 2 through opposite corners and 2 through midpoints of sides.

questions.question: A pizza is round. What shape is it?
questions.explanation: A whole pizza is a circle — round with no sides.

questions.question: Which shape can you find on a football (soccer ball)?
questions.explanation: A football has hexagons (6 sides) and pentagons (5 sides) stitched together.

questions.question: A tile on the floor is usually shaped like a ___.
questions.explanation: Floor tiles are usually squares — 4 equal sides that fit together without gaps.

questions.question: Which shape does NOT have any sides?
questions.explanation: A circle has no straight sides — it is curved all the way around.

questions.question: A traffic yield sign is shaped like a ___.
questions.explanation: A yield sign is a triangle — 3 sides pointing downward.

questions.question: Which shape is a honeycomb cell?
questions.explanation: Bees build honeycombs in hexagons — 6-sided shapes that fit together perfectly.

questions.question: A door is shaped like a ___.
questions.explanation: A door is a rectangle — taller than it is wide, with 4 sides and 4 corners.

questions.question: Which shape has ALL sides equal AND all corners the same?
questions.explanation: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 equal corners (all 90 degrees). A rectangle has equal corners but NOT equal sides.
